  "question_intent": "Clarification on investment confidence and future guidance",
  "main_topics": ["investment confidence", "future guidance", "bank performance"],

  "question_quote": "A quick follow up, because the guidance for 2028 has not been changed, if I got it right. So, it means that you have more confidence. So, I mean, this type of [additional] investment that you plan to make, will increase your confidence in your ability to deliver the results. Is that the way to read this process?",
  "answer_quote": "Yes, increased confidence. Look, thank you very much. We appreciate the time and the attention you've given. We look forward to meeting some of you on the road in the next few days. What I would say to sum up is when you look at these results [as] a whole, we're 10 [quarters] into the plan we announced in 2024, and two quarters into the plan we announced earlier this year. In every quarter, in every way, cumulatively and individually, we've been meeting our guidelines, sometimes a little more than others, but generally, it's been a part of progress in returns, a part of progress in distributions, a part of progress in efficiency in the bank and in our capabilities in the bank more broadly. We are a bigger part of the UK ecosystem than we were. We maintain our strength and are a bigger part of the global ecosystem, especially in Equities and Financing, as we've spoken. We are using the increased revenues from this first half to, A, increase distributions to our shareholders. B, to continue to continue to remain safe and well-capitalised, and C, to invest in our business for the long-term benefit of this business, both in terms of the revenue capability, the cost efficiency, and the ability to bring better products safely and quickly to our customers. And we want to do, as we said, in the UK for the entirety of the customer experience and continue to be a great and important partner and a growing and important partner to our institutional clients worldwide. Thank you. Have a good day.",

}
